text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r p-r-o-c-e-e-d to i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y item 021 in t-h-e c-l-o-s-e-d e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e r-e-c-o-r-d and l-e-f-t a c-o-u-n-t s-h-e-e-t as t-h-e p-r-i-m-a-r-y a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
2) t-h-e s-u-b-j-e-c-t m-a-r-k-e-d the i-t-e-m as c-l-o-s-e-d in t-h-e i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y l-e-d-g-e-r and l-e-f-t a s-t-a-t-u-s f-l-a-g as t-h-e o-n-l-y a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-c-o-n-d r-e-v-i-e-w l-a-y-e-r.
3) t-h-e a-g-e-n-t r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d the c-o-u-n-t e-n-t-r-y in t-h-e w-a-r-e-h-o-u-s-e s-y-s-t-e-m and l-e-f-t a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p a-s t-h-e d-a-t-a a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the q-u-a-l-i-t-y c-o-n-t-r-o-l s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g.
4) t-h-e t-e-a-m l-e-a-d-e-r a-p-p-r-o-v-e-d the c-l-o-s-u-r-e p-r-o-c-e-s-s and l-e-f-t a s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e l-o-g as t-h-e a-u-d-i-t a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l r-e-c-o-u-n-t c-h-e-c-k.
5) t-h-e s-t-a-f-f e-n-t-e-r-e-d the d-e-b-r-i-e-f n-o-t-e-s in t-h-e l-o-g f-i-l-e and l-e-f-t a t-e-x-t r-e-c-o-r-d as t-h-e p-e-r-m-a-n-e-n-t a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-a-n-a-g-e-m-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t s-t-e-p.
